biography.ja: ニジニ・ノヴゴロドに生まれ、ほぼ独学で作曲を学んだ。ロシア民族楽派を志す作曲家たちのグループ「五人組」の中心的指導者として、ムソルグスキーやリムスキー=コルサコフら年少の作曲家たちを助言と指導で導いた。壮年期に精神的な危機から一時作曲活動を離れ、鉄道会社の職員として働いた時期もある。
biography.en: Born in Nizhny Novgorod, he was largely self-taught as a composer. As the central leader of "The Five," a group of composers dedicated to Russian musical nationalism, he guided younger colleagues, including Mussorgsky and Rimsky-Korsakov, through advice and direct mentorship. During a personal crisis in midlife he withdrew from composing for a time and even worked as a railway employee.

style.ja: 西欧の音楽教育に頼らない独自の道を歩み、ロシア民謡や東洋的な旋律素材を色彩豊かな管弦楽法で描く作風を確立した。代表的な交響詩は、コーカサス地方の伝説に基づく異国情緒豊かな題材を扱い、幻想的な和声とオーケストレーションで聴き手を魅了する。
style.en: Charting his own course apart from formal Western European musical training, he established a style that depicted Russian folk song and Orientalist melodic material in richly colored orchestration. His best-known symphonic poem draws on an exotic legend from the Caucasus, captivating listeners with fantastical harmony and orchestration.

impact.ja: 作曲家個人としての作品数は多くないが、「五人組」の指導者として、ロシア民族音楽の理念を若い世代に浸透させた功績は計り知れない。門下のリムスキー=コルサコフはその後さらに管弦楽法を洗練させ、ロシア音楽教育の中心的存在となっており、彼の助言がなければロシア国民楽派の展開は大きく異なっていたと考えられている。
impact.en: His personal output as a composer is not large, but his contribution as leader of "The Five" in spreading the ideals of Russian musical nationalism to the younger generation is immeasurable. His pupil Rimsky-Korsakov went on to refine orchestration even further and became a central figure in Russian music education, and it is widely thought that without his guidance the development of the Russian nationalist school would have taken a very different course.
